title: Aromatic Light French Chicken Gratin
description: This dish features chicken cooked in sake and topped with a light, umami-rich mother sauce, perfect for a special occasion. It is a whole30-friendly, light French burgundy-inspired recipe.
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine sake, coconut cream, lemon juice, thyme, garlic powder, salt, and pepper, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the sauce for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Add the chicken to the saucepan and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and spoon some of the sauce over the top of each breast.
Bake the chicken in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the chicken hot, spooning some of the remaining sauce over the top of each breast.
